rationale: Clipping changes the answer in official examples. Random independent demonstrations can accidentally teach fit-only behavior, so sample-index parity makes every normal three-demo-plus-query episode contain both branches while retaining random geometry.
summary: Sequential four-pair lessons alternate full-fit and clipping behavior.

rationale: Without this constraint, proximity can solve the task without counting object cells or frame interiors. All 1,200 strict-census draws contain the rebuttal.
summary: Every generated scene includes at least one object whose nearest frame is not its area-matched frame.
